instructions: Complete the table below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage for each answer.

items.prompt: Phase one — What the researchers did: The animals took part in (1) ........ sessions in all; in the first of these one part of the pool held a big two-way mirror on some days and a clear panel of the same size on the rest.
items.evidence: Between February and November 2001 the animals took part in 98 separate sessions split into two phases.
items.explanation: Paragraph B says that between February and November 2001 the animals took part in 98 separate sessions split into two phases; so the answer is '98'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Phase one — What the researchers did: On certain days one part of the pool held a big two-way mirror; on the rest it was replaced by a clear (1) ........ screen of the same size.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: In the first phase a large two-way mirror was lowered into one section of their pool on some days and, on other days, a transparent acrylic panel of identical size was used instead as a control, so that researchers could distinguish curiosity about a novel object from a specific response to a reflection.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Bosluk levhanin malzemesini istiyordu ve o cerceveye 'plastic', 'glass', 'plexiglass' gibi baska malzeme adlari da esit derecede oturuyordu; dogru sozcugu tutturmak buyuk olcude sansa kaliyordu (blind_basis: guess). Malzeme adi isteyen bir bosluk tek adaya kilitlenemedigi icin yuva bosaltildi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Bosluk malzemeden calismanin kendi sayisina tasindi: butun calismanin kac oturumdan olustugu (B/2). Tek dogru var, tahmin edilemiyor. Kanit B/3'ten B/2'ye gectigi icin B paragrafinda ucu de ayri cumleye oturuyor (dogru-yanlis 8 -> B/1, bu soru -> B/2, dogru-yanlis 7 -> B/4).

items.prompt: Phase one — What they saw: Acts hardly ever seen at other times — trails of bubbles, gentle (2) ........ , necks stretched out, a flipper turned round — occurred only at the mirror.
items.evidence: They lingered near it, angled their bodies to bring particular areas into view, and produced a cluster of behaviours rarely seen elsewhere in their daily routine: blowing strings of bubbles while facing the glass, performing slow barrel rolls, stretching their necks, opening their mouths wide towards the surface and rotating a pectoral flipper as if to inspect it.
items.explanation: Paragraph C lists the unusual behaviours seen in front of the mirror and includes 'performing slow barrel rolls'; since bubbles, neck-stretching and flipper-turning are already given in the list, the gap needs 'barrel rolls'.

items.prompt: Phase two — What the researchers did: A harmless mark measuring five to (3) ........ across was put where the animal could not see it unaided; on other trials the same contact left nothing visible.
items.evidence: A harmless cosmetic mark, five to eight centimetres across, was applied to a part of the body the whale could not see without a mirror, most often just behind an eye or an ear.
items.explanation: Paragraph D says the harmless mark measured five to eight centimetres across; since the cell already gives the lower figure, the answer is 'eight centimetres'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Phase two — What the researchers did: A safe (3) ........ mark 5–8 cm wide was put where the animal could not see it unaided; on other trials the same contact left nothing visible.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: A harmless cosmetic mark, five to eight centimetres across, was applied to a part of the body the whale could not see without a mirror, most often just behind an eye or an ear.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Bosluk deriye uygulanan zararsiz isaretin turunu soruyordu ve bu kavramin karsiligi cerceveden okunuyordu: model parcasiz uc turda da dogru kavrami ('dye') verdi. Ayna testinde deriye konan zararsiz isareti soran her cerceve boya kavramini kendiliginden veriyor, yani sizinti cercevede degil boslugun hedefindeydi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Bosluk kavramdan olcuye kaydirildi: isaretin buyuklugunun ust ucu. Alt uc ('five to') hucrede verildigi icin cevap yalniz D/2'den okunur, tahminle bulunamaz. Kanit cumlesi degismedi, hedefi degisti.

items.prompt: Phase two — What they saw: With a visible mark Natasha held the spot up to the glass for 3 minutes 40 seconds over (4) ........ visits.
items.evidence: When a real mark had been applied, she oriented the marked patch of skin towards the mirror repeatedly, spending a total of three minutes and forty seconds doing so across fourteen separate approaches.
items.explanation: Paragraph E says that, with a real mark, Natasha spread a total of three minutes forty seconds across fourteen separate approaches; since the duration is given in the question, the answer is 'fourteen'.

items.prompt: Phase two — What they saw: ... but with an unseen mark for only (5) ........ over four visits.
items.evidence: When she carried an invisible sham mark instead, the equivalent behaviour lasted only twenty-three seconds across four approaches, a difference the researchers regarded as strong evidence that she was inspecting the mark itself rather than merely enjoying the mirror.
items.explanation: Paragraph E says that with the invisible sham mark, the same behaviour lasted only twenty-three seconds across four approaches; the answer is therefore 'twenty-three seconds'.

items.prompt: The wider picture — What they saw: The list already included elephants, magpies and even a cleaner fish no bigger than a (6) ........ .
items.evidence: Combined with earlier reports in elephants, magpies and even a species of cleaner wrasse no larger than a human finger, the beluga findings support the view that some form of mirror self-recognition has evolved independently, more than once, in animals with very different brains and very different lifestyles, rather than being a single trait inherited from a common ancestor.
items.explanation: Paragraph G says earlier reports of this ability include elephants, magpies and even a species of cleaner wrasse no larger than a human finger; so the answer is 'human finger'.

revision.onceki_prompt: Both responsive animals — What they saw: Each of them studied the reflection with the (6) ........ , hinting that one side of the brain deals with this task.
revision.ne_degisti: Hucrenin sonundaki 'hinting that one side of the brain deals with this task' ibaresi kaldirildi. Yanallasma (lateralisation) cagrisimi, hayvan davranisinda sikca bildirilen sag goz tercihini dogrudan hatirlatiyordu. Ibare gidince hucreye 'the same eye' de en az 'right eye' kadar uyuyor - ustelik 'Both / Each of them' vurgusu sezgiyi oraya cekiyor. KISMI duzeltme: geriye sag/sol ikilisinde zayif bir sag onyargisi kaliyor, E7 ayrica olcmeli.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Both responsive animals — What they saw: Each of them studied the reflection with the (6) ........ .
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Both whales, notably, preferred to view the mirror with their right eye, a bias that hints at some degree of lateralised processing in how the brain handles this kind of visual information.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Cevap genel bilgiyle geliyordu: hayvan davranisi calismalarinda gorsel uyaranlarin islenmesinde sag goz tercihinin bildirilmesi bilinen bir oruntu, ustelik sag/sol ikilisinde tahminin tutma sansi zaten yuksekti. 2026-08-08'deki kismi duzeltme (beyin ibaresinin cikarilmasi) bu sag onyargisini kapatmamisti.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Satirin ekseni degistirildi: son satir artik iki hayvanin bakis yonunu degil, bulgunun daha once hangi turlerde bildirildigini ozetliyor ve bosluk kaynagin kendi olcusune ('bir insan parmagindan buyuk olmayan') aciliyor. Kanit F/3'ten pasajda hic kullanilmayan G/2'ye tasindi; sag/sol tahmini artik hicbir sey kazandirmiyor. Ayrica pasajin A/2 cumlesi 'cleaner fish' dedigi icin hucredeki ifade oraya benziyor ama olcuyu yalniz G/2 veriyor.
